2609.03894.title: CROCODIL: Cross-Model Code Editing with LLMs
2609.03894.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous tools for code generation and editing. However, development teams often use multiple LLM assistants. Different developers may prefer different models, and individual developers may switch between models across different coding sessions. Because of this, the edits any one model makes are frequently applied to foreign code originally generated by another model. These LLMs are often trained on different datasets, and as a result have different stylistic preferences. Do LLMs behave differently when they edit foreign code originally written by a different LLM with a different coding style? We find that models tend to make more, and often excessive, edits on foreign code. We introduce CROCODIL (Cross-model Code Editing with LLMs), a post-training framework for reducing excessive edits while preserving functional correctness. CROCODIL's similarity reward penalizes large changes, while its execution reward scores build and test success. We use the product of these two rewards to encourage the policy to decrease the edit size without decreasing the edit task success rate. CROCODIL is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/Crocodil.
2609.03894.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已成為代碼生成和編輯的普遍工具。<lb/>然而，開發團隊經常使用多個 LLM 助手。<lb/>不同的開發者可能偏好不同的模型，而個別開發者可能在不同的編碼會話中切換模型。<lb/>因此，任何一個模型所做的編輯經常應用於最初由另一個模型生成的外部代碼。<lb/>這些 LLM 通常是在不同的數據集上進行訓練的，因此具有不同的風格偏好。<lb/>當 LLM 編輯最初由不同的 LLM 以不同編碼風格撰寫的外部代碼時，LLM 的行為是否會有所不同？<lb/>我們發現模型在外部代碼上往往會進行更多且通常過度的編輯。<lb/>我們介紹了 CROCODIL（跨模型代碼編輯與 LLM），這是一個後訓練框架，用於減少過度編輯，同時保持功能正確性。<lb/>CROCODIL 的相似性獎勵對大幅變更進行懲罰，而其執行獎勵則評分構建和測試的成功。<lb/>我們使用這兩個獎勵的乘積來鼓勵策略減少編輯大小，而不降低編輯任務的成功率。<lb/>CROCODIL 可在 https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/Crocodil 獲得。
